note: Curated Matriculation isomer sets. Specs may reference molecules.json ids or embed chain/graph specs.

sets.title: Chain isomers of C4H10
sets.blurb: Same molecular formula, different carbon skeleton. Both are saturated alkanes.

isomers.name: 2-Methylpropane
isomers.diff: Branched: a methyl group on carbon-2.

sets.title: Chain isomers of C5H12
sets.blurb: Three alkanes share C5H12. Branching lowers boiling point compared with the straight chain.

isomers.name: 2,2-Dimethylpropane
isomers.diff: Central carbon bonded to four methyl groups (neopentane).

sets.title: Position and geometric isomers of C4H8
sets.blurb: Butene isomers differ by double-bond position; but-2-ene also shows cis–trans (geometric) isomerism.

isomers.name: But-1-ene
isomers.diff: Double bond between C1 and C2.

isomers.name: cis-But-2-ene
isomers.diff: Double bond at C2–C3; methyl groups on the same side.

isomers.name: trans-But-2-ene
isomers.diff: Double bond at C2–C3; methyl groups on opposite sides.

sets.title: Functional isomers of C2H6O
sets.blurb: Ethanol and methoxymethane have the same formula but different functional groups — alcohol vs ether.

isomers.name: Ethanol
isomers.diff: Contains an –OH group (alcohol); hydrogen bonds; liquid, b.p. 78 °C.

isomers.name: Methoxymethane
isomers.diff: Contains C–O–C (ether); no OH hydrogen bonding; gas at room temperature.

sets.title: Isomers of C3H8O
sets.blurb: Two alcohol position isomers and one ether functional isomer share C3H8O.

isomers.name: Methoxyethane
isomers.diff: Ether functional isomer of the propanols.

sets.title: Functional isomers of C3H6O2
sets.blurb: A carboxylic acid and an ester can share the same molecular formula.

isomers.name: Propanoic acid
isomers.diff: –COOH acid group; higher boiling point; acidic solution.

isomers.name: Methyl ethanoate
isomers.diff: Ester; fruity smell; no acidic hydrogen like a carboxylic acid.

isomers.name: Ethyl methanoate
isomers.diff: Another ester isomer of the same formula.
